newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kong Tai shrs soar after trading resumes.
newsitem.headline: Kong Tai shrs soar after trading resumes.

text.p: Shares of property firm Kong Tai International Holdings Co Ltd soared after resuming trading on hopes of stronger earnings after Pearl Oriental Holdings Ltd took a stake in the company.
Kong Tai shares rose HK$0.185 or 80.43 percent to HK$0.415 in early trade. Its shares had been suspended since May 23.
"Hopes of a strong share performance and better earnings outlook after Pearl Oriental took a stake fueled demand by short term investors," said a sales manager at a regional brokerage.
"Past performance of Pearl Oriental shares gave investors hope of possible upside potential for Kong Tai," he said.
Brokers said the surge was expected to be short-lived because investors might take profits following a rally.
Volume was 580.17 million shares worth HK$206.02 million.
Earlier this month, Kong Tai issued 582 million new shares at HK$0.25 each to revitalise businesses and for the purchase of a 20 percent stake in an engineering firm.
Pearl Oriental took up 150 million shares, or 11.10 percent of Kong Tai's enlarged share capital.
Kong Tai said earlier its shareholders approved its placement proposal in a general meeting held last Friday.
Pearl Oriental shares were unchanged at HK$4.575.
